# Kautusang Bayan Blg. 05, Serye Taong 2024 (Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2024)

**Ordinansa ng Pagliligpit ng Seat of Local Government ng Bayan ng Pitogo, Lalawigan ng Quezon**

## Summary

This ordinance authorizes the transfer of the seat of local government of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province]] to a new location. Note: While this was filed as Municipal Ordinance No. 03, it was numbered as Kautusang Bayan Blg. 05 in the original document. The ordinance was reviewed and declared **valid** by the [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] of Quezon under SP Resolution No. 2024-0435.

## Key Provisions

- Authorizes the transfer/relocation of the seat of local government of Pitogo
- Identifies the new location for the municipal government center
- Provides for the logistics and timeline of the transfer
- Complies with Section 442 of RA 7160 regarding the seat of the LGU

## Provincial Review

The [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] of [[Quezon Province]] reviewed this ordinance under **SP Resolution No. 2024-0435** dated April 29, 2024, and declared it **VALID**. The transfer of seat of government is a matter requiring provincial review under the [[Local Government Code]].

- [[Sangguniang Bayan ng Pitogo]]
